I am a PhD candidate in Health Economics and Policy in the [Department of Health Policy and Management](https://publichealth.jhu.edu/departments/health-policy-and-management) at the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health. **I am on the 2026–27 academic job market** and expect to defend my dissertation in May 2027.

I study how the design of public programs shapes access to care, health, and economic well-being for the people they serve. My work spans the **ACA marketplaces**, **Medicare Advantage**, **Medicaid**, and **SNAP**. Prior to my PhD, I was a pre-doctoral fellow at the Tobin Center for Economic Policy at Yale University.
